svg.title: Building a faster Python re: six original engines, no proven winner
svg.desc: Pinned Python 3.14.6 is the verified reference. Rust and C both compile from first-party source, but their latest real matching tests still fail. The new Rust compatibility campaign is source-frozen and blocked because the independently attested private native-build root is not established. Its 13 future workers have not run. All 31,237 original cases, 13 complete original result groups, and six complete mismatch events remain unchanged. No compressed archive or hidden 4,194,304-case holdout was opened. Speed, memory, runtime independence, and a winner are not measured.
svg.text: Building a faster Python re
Our own engines. Python is the reference. No candidate is proven compatible or faster.
Overall result compared with Python
0 compatible candidates; speed NOT MEASURED
A successful native build does not mean the engine matches Python.
How the original, from-scratch engines are doing
The same frozen Python compatibility tests apply to every family. This is not a speed ranking.

Verified reference; stable CPython 3.14.6

Why the next Rust test is not running
BLOCKED PENDING INDEPENDENTLY ATTESTED PRIVATE ROOT
The Rust V11 original campaign is SOURCE FROZEN. Its 13 workers are planned; 0 have run.
Native build root and individual native artifact hashes: NOT ESTABLISHED / NOT MEASURED.
Future inspection requires separate authorization. This chart does not inspect, discover, or guess a root.
What has and has not been measured
Original compatibility cases: 31,237 across 13 complete groups; six complete failure events preserved.
Supplemental Python reference: 8,244 cases. New candidate matching: NOT RUN.
Speed, memory, confidence intervals and runtime independence: NOT MEASURED / NOT ESTABLISHED.
